reproduction_levels.RECOMPUTED_FROM_INCLUDED_OBSERVATIONS: Scalar/table aggregation only, where the public CPU verifier implements the corresponding reduction
reproduction_levels.INCLUDED_TENSOR_POINT_CHECKS: Small selected fixtures support explicitly bounded arithmetic comparisons; they are not representative full trajectories

claim_boundary: Curation establishes evidence identity, not new model quality, numerical success, or deployment promotion
